build_mlp_graph_independent: build an MLPGraphIndependent model that independently encodes edge, node, and global graph attributes with MLP layers
build_mlp_graph_network: build an MLPGraphNetwork model that performs message-passing on edge, node, and global graph attributes
build_encode_process_decode: build an EncodeProcessDecode model with encoder, core processing steps, and decoder for graph neural network inference
create_mlp_model: create an MLP model with LayerNorm for use as edge, node, or global network in graph net modules
test_encode_process_decode: test the EncodeProcessDecode model with configurable edge, node, and global output sizes and processing steps
